market.question: Will Solana dip to $80 in May?

assessment.reasoning: SOL is around $92.38 on May 9, 2026 with a 24h range of $87.69-$92.45 (CoinGecko, CoinDesk). To resolve Yes, SOL needs a low at or below $80 — about 13% below current. SOL is volatile (monthly ranges of 20-30% are common) but the trend has been recovering; 24h low of $87.69 is already 9% off the current. A meaningful crypto pullback would need to extend further to hit $80.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Sensitivity to broader crypto risk; a sharp BTC drop would magnify SOL downside.
